title: Integrated lesson blueprint
note: A lesson whose theory has the first heading below is an integrated lesson and must follow every step, in this order. Existing lessons are not changed until they are rewritten to this shape.

steps.heading: Hook
steps.purpose: A real situation or question that makes the idea matter before it is explained.

steps.heading: Predict
steps.purpose: The learner commits to a guess first. It ends with a question.

steps.heading: Plain words
steps.purpose: The idea in everyday words, with its terms defined.

steps.heading: Diagram
steps.purpose: One picture of how the idea fits together, drawn from the shared visual grammar.

steps.heading: Worked example
steps.purpose: One example worked through with real figures.

steps.heading: Case
steps.purpose: A real case or moment from history, from the evidence library, with its source.

steps.heading: Bridge
steps.purpose: What the idea means for the technology side and for the business side.

steps.heading: Say it back
steps.purpose: The learner explains it in their own words.

steps.heading: Use it
steps.purpose: One thing to do with real data or real work this week.
